hero.title: Digital Citizen in the Social Media Era
hero.description: Reshape how we interact, learn, and develop in the digital space. Equip yourself with essential skills to become a civilized, safe, and creative digital citizen.

hero.title: Building an Excellent Generation of
hero.description: An in-depth research project on the digital competency of Vietnamese students in a globalized context, aimed at building a safe, creative, and responsible digital environment.

objectives.title: Research Objectives
items: Systematize the theoretical foundation of digital citizenship as a basis for analyzing behavior in the social media environment.
Analyze the current status of social media usage behavior among Vietnamese students to clarify the formation of digital identity.
Evaluate students' awareness levels regarding information security, privacy, and risks in the digital environment.
Propose directions and solutions to enhance digital citizenship capacity, focusing on safe and responsible social media usage skills.

significance.title: Practical Significance
significance.description: The research helps bridge the gap between technological capacity and social responsibility, while orienting safe and effective social media usage to cope with risks and manage digital footprints professionally.

methodology.title: Research Methodology
methodology.subtitle: Approached through secondary data, ensuring objectivity and reliability.

methods.title: Document Analysis
methods.description: Utilizing data and evidence from online academic sources, including research reports, scientific articles, and highly reliable academic databases.

methods.title: Theoretical Synthesis
methods.description: Systematizing the theoretical foundation of digital citizenship and related competency components to serve as a basis for analyzing behavior in the social media environment.

methods.title: Comparative Analysis
methods.description: Analyzing, evaluating, and comparing available secondary data sources to strengthen the objectivity and reliability of the research results.
